detail: ticket 2: first merge passed, 0 merge failure(s), 10 steps; recall showed 3 fact(s)

memories_after: [Fact] In the docs project, new files are checked for tracking eligibility with git status --short and git check-ignore.
[Fact] In the docs project, file contents can be verified in PowerShell with Get-Content, Select-String -SimpleMatch, and [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes for byte/line-ending checks.
[Fact] The docs project repo root contains README.md, agenium.toml, artifacts/, deliverables/ and notes/ directories.
[Fact] Docs project deliverable files follow the style of deliverables/hello.txt: an 'Owner: docs-team' header line followed by the content line.
[Fact] In the docs project worktrees files are written with LF line endings and no BOM, which is verified in PowerShell by dumping bytes with [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes.
[Lesson] The docs project's real pre-merge rules are not necessarily listed in agenium.toml ([checks] pre_merge may be empty), so the enforced rule must be discovered from the merge check output.
[Fact] Agenium tickets in the docs project are worked in worktrees at projects/docs/.agenium/worktrees/<ticket> on branch agenium/<ticket>.
[Fact] The docs project keeps team documents in the deliverables/ and reports/ directories, as stated in its README.md.
[Fact] In the docs project, every team document placed in deliverables/ or reports/ must have exactly 'Owner: docs-team' as its first line; the pre-merge check rejects files that lack it.
